settings.title: Exclusive access
settings.body:
This is your exclusive member area. Special products and rewards-only offers will appear here.

For now, this page is a private placeholder for logged-in customers only.

settings.title: Future access rules
settings.body: This page is structured so you can later add more granular restrictions based on customer tags, metafields, or app-managed entitlements.

settings.title: Private member merchandising
settings.body: Use this area later for curated collections, hidden products, loyalty offers, or customer-specific promotions.

settings.heading: Secret Shop
settings.intro: This is your exclusive member area. Special products and rewards-only offers will appear here.
settings.member_note: This Secret Shop is ready for customer credit balances, product credit costs, and a future Salesforce-driven discount engine at checkout.
settings.logged_out_title: Please log in to access the Secret Shop
settings.logged_out_message: You need to log in with your Shopify customer account to enter this private member area.
settings.secret_shop_helper_text: Choose a collection in the theme editor for this page. Each reward product should have a portal credit cost metafield so the portal can show its credit value.
